title: author the intro screenplay
summary: `transcript.json` + `segments.json` + `concept.json` + `card-library/DESIGN.md` → `intro-film/screenplay.json`. Runs only when `run-config.json` has `intro: "film"`. Reads the design system and the logo registry, and must not read `catalog.json` — the intro keeps full creative freedom. Reviewed at 140, approved at 150, rendered at 160.
